name: code-context-map
description: Generate and re-sync an AI-readable code context map (ranked, token-budgeted Markdown of files, imports, signatures, and typed boundary calls) for a target project (or, from a seed file, its import chain). Opt-in; not part of default task init. Use when fast structural orientation is needed before editing, when onboarding to an unfamiliar repo, or when an existing map is stale. Do not use to locate one behavior (use code-locate), for blast radius (use impact-analysis), for a database schema (use db-context-supabase), or without a target codebase path.
